result:
These queries are written from the documentation page alone and none was run, so any of them could fail on a verb detail I guessed.

- **Assumptions:**
  - `groupBy ~(key)` accepts a quote key and string results.
  - `lines`, `sort` and `sum` behave on the file text as the page's verb list suggests.
  - `mulOf` accepts parenthesised pipelines as modifiers.
- **Guards:** For missing or null fields I used `at` with `coalesce` or `ne null`, since strict `/k` reads fail where a key is absent. I added a non-blank filter on the line-based files so a trailing empty line can't break a strict `at` read.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | filter ~(/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * (/name)
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/labels * (/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(/login))}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: unionOf /dependencies /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~/0 * ([(/0 | keyword) /1] | join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(split " " | at 1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | at 2) * count
T11: lines * (split " ") | flat | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") * (drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * {:customer /1 :amt (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/customer) * (/ * /amt | sum | round 2) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] * (lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
